description: NaNd(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.74 Å. Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.48 Å) and three longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Nd and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom.
